item.title: v0.0.9 release and node hardening
item.body:
Ship the release that carries the renewed spork window and the fixes merged since v0.0.8,
with reproducible builds and vulnerability checks, and get it onto enough Pillars before
the window opens (roadmap M1).

- Cut `release/0.0.9` with the spork renewal and the pool-byte-mismatch fixes
- Re-enable `govulncheck`, reproducible builds with a pinned toolchain, a release checklist
- Node-local fixes from the zBTC lab: the slot wait, a release checklist review
item.author: dev-ada
